account_oauth_states.lifecycle: single-use and 10-minute expiry; account disablement stops new work; expired rows are removable by bounded cleanup

account_sessions.privacy: session token digest only; never returned and never valid on tenant routes
account_sessions.system_access: explicit account/auth system scope only; never tenant or customer Admin access
account_sessions.lifecycle: revocable and 12-hour expiry; account disablement stops use; bounded cleanup of expired rows

account_organization_requests.system_access: explicit account system scope only; never tenant or customer Admin access

organization_settings.privacy: organizations.admin at organization scope; ownership transfer restricted to current human owner
organization_settings.system_access: explicit provisioning or operator recovery only
organization_settings.lifecycle: active tenant; shared org transaction guard protects ownership and admin access

organization_lifecycle.privacy: owner and organization admins read state; only the owner (deletion request/cancel) and operator scripts write
organization_lifecycle.system_access: named 'lifecycle' system purpose: bounded discovery of pending deletions and per-organization state reads; operator scripts use the database owner connection
organization_lifecycle.lifecycle: retained after deletion as the tombstone accountability record (reason, actors, timestamps); never purged

waitlist_entries.privacy: public sign-up data readable only through its private token (answers) or the operator script; never by any tenant or account

waitlist_entries.lifecycle: bounded retention purge (WEAVES_WAITLIST_RETENTION_DAYS, default 365); operator erasure on request; never exported or purged with an organization

waitlist_submissions.privacy: public sign-up data readable only through its private token (answers) or the operator script; never by any tenant or account

waitlist_submissions.lifecycle: bounded retention purge (WEAVES_WAITLIST_RETENTION_DAYS, default 365); operator erasure on request; never exported or purged with an organization
